name: voicebox-extension

scripts.build: bun build ./src/popup/popup.ts --outdir dist/popup --target browser && bun build ./src/content/content.ts --outdir dist/content --target browser && bun build ./src/background/background.ts --outdir dist/background --target browser && bun build ./src/offscreen/offscreen.ts --outdir dist/offscreen --target browser && bun build ./src/offscreen/engine.worker.ts --outdir dist/offscreen --target browser && cp -r static/* dist/
scripts.watch: bun build ./src/popup/popup.ts --outdir dist/popup --target browser --watch & bun build ./src/content/content.ts --outdir dist/content --target browser --watch & bun build ./src/background/background.ts --outdir dist/background --target browser --watch & bun build ./src/offscreen/offscreen.ts --outdir dist/offscreen --target browser --watch & bun build ./src/offscreen/engine.worker.ts --outdir dist/offscreen --target browser --watch
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && bun run build && mkdir -p release && cd dist && zip -qr -X ../release/lector-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip . -x '.DS_Store' '*/.DS_Store'

description: Listen to any web page with natural AI voices, entirely on your device (Chrome extension, Kokoro TTS).
